# Storm Framework

> Tool Suite for Offensive Security Framework

## Framework Language
> Python, Golang, Rust, Bash, PowerShell

## Documentation & Feature
- [Connection Runtime Service](docs/storm-framework.wiki/CRS-ENGINE.md): Network engine explanation.
- [Build Module](docs/storm-framework.wiki/MODULE-GUIDE.md): Explanation of Module creation.
- [Logger Dock](docs/storm-framework.wiki/LOGGER.md): Fast Logger machine explanation.

## Installation Documentation
- [Installation Docker](docs/storm-framework.wiki/INSTALLATION-DOCKER.md): Docker installer explanation.
- [Installation Venv](docs/storm-framework.wiki/INSTALLATION-VENV.md): Venv installer explanation.
- [Installation Linux](docs/storm-framework.wiki/INSTALLATION-LINUX.md): Standard Linux installer explained.
- [Installation Termux](docs/storm-framework.wiki/INSTALLATION-TERMUX.md): Termux/Android installer explanation.

- [license](LICENSE): GPL-3.0

## Project Structure & Core Entry Points
- [App Entry](smfstart): Starting, Interface, Prompt, Boot.
- [Update Entry](smfupdate): Update tool, Source Code, Version.
- [Template Load](modules/): Auxiliary, Scanner, Osint, Fuzzers, Exploit, Payload.
- [Connection Runtime Service](lib/roar/crs/): Managing Runtime connections.
- [Logger Manager](lib/roar/logging/): Manage internal logs.
- [Plugin Manager](lib/roar/plugin/): Manage service plugins.
- [Gathering](docker/): Collection of Linux/Windows/MacOS Docker installations.
- [Feature Examples](example/): Examples of feature implementation and setup.
- [data framework](data/data.json): Metadata Storm Framework.

## Related Websites & Related Repositories
